rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a short, interactive training course.

example.english: This workshop will teach everyone how to make natural skincare products.
example.traditional: 呢個工作坊會教大家整天然護膚品。

rows.note: Use this for a room or site where manufacturing or light industrial work is done, rather than a training course.

example.english: They are making wooden furniture at the workshop.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺工場度整緊木製家具。
